About.title: Who is DE|TECH?
About.history2002: Founded in 2002 with medical equipment imports, Demirtaş Teknoloji transformed its industry expertise into manufacturing operations.
About.history2016: Production activities began at Başkent OSB in 2016, integrating into the defense industry supply chain with a vertically integrated structure.
About.historyNow: Today, operating with 29+ CNC machines and an expert team across 1,300 m² of closed production area with series production capacity.
About.visionText: To become a leading brand that delivers high-quality products globally, using innovative technologies with a team of industry experts.
About.missionText: To maximize end-user satisfaction by embracing sustainable quality and contributing to society and the world.
About.strength1Desc: µm-level tolerance manufacturing with Swiss CNC
